title: have the UI brief print the resolved -renders path and say whether it equals TMPDIR

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-234354-c0f6, project ork, item S475:

have the UI brief print the resolved -renders path and say whether it equals TMPDIR

Evidence: brief.go:173 uses TempDir while brief.go:188 prints TMPDir as "Your temp directory"; in run ork-20261119-234354-c0f6 they differ.
